column2: Added "Rounds by date" to the "Data" tab. Set break date-times on the timestamp to make a column that divides responses into "Round 1", "Round 2", … (you can name them freely). There is no limit on the number of rounds, and break candidates are suggested where responses paused. The new column can be used as the groups to compare in cross tabulation, t tests, ANOVA and so on, and rounds can be compared with 100% bar charts, a pie per round, or mean and CI plots.

You can specify that the same people answered in more than one round (without identifying individuals). Tests comparing rounds with such a column then note in the results and the report that they are an approximation treating each round's responses as independent groups.
Date-time can now be chosen as a column type, to fix a timestamp that was not detected automatically. "Response timeline" now also reads the date format of English Google Forms (month/day/year).
Added a citation request and the author's name to "Software used" in the report and to "About this app".
